# Register Aset Visual (Game Asset Maker)

Seluruh aset visual mematuhi `ART_BIBLE.md` (flat-shaded storybook diorama gouache style, palet krem/teal/honey/sage, tanpa teks di dalam gambar).

| Nama Berkas | Resolusi | Format | Deskripsi & Peruntukan |
|-------------|----------|--------|------------------------|
| `cover.png` | 1280x720 | PNG RGBA | Layar pembuka & sambutan awal game |
| `sky.png` | 2048x1024 | PNG RGBA | Skydome silinder panorama siang hangat |
| `ground-hub.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Ubin lantai diorama area hub utama |
| `ground-station1.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Ubin zona Stasiun 1 (Alat Gelas & Presisi) |
| `ground-station2.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Ubin zona Stasiun 2 (Bahan & Piktogram B3) |
| `ground-station3.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Ubin zona Stasiun 3 (K3 & Spill Kit) |
| `panel-paper.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Latar perkamen Panel 3D CanvasTexture |
| `portrait-alkim.png` | 512x512 | PNG RGBA | Potret dialog Prof. Alkim |
| `portrait-tara.png` | 512x512 | PNG RGBA | Potret dialog Dr. Tara |
| `portrait-rani.png` | 512x512 | PNG RGBA | Potret dialog Rani |
| `portrait-bima.png` | 512x512 | PNG RGBA | Potret dialog Bima |
| `npc-alkim.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Standing sprite cutout Prof. Alkim |
| `npc-tara.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Standing sprite cutout Dr. Tara |
| `npc-rani.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Standing sprite cutout Rani |
| `npc-bima.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Standing sprite cutout Bima |
| `icon-quest.png` | 256x256 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Ikon quest tanda seru mengapung di atas kepala NPC |
| `icon-tool.png` | 256x256 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Ikon instrumen & alat ukur |
| `icon-hazard.png` | 256x256 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Ikon bahaya bahan kimia B3 |
| `icon-safety.png` | 256x256 | PNG RGBA Alpha | Ikon tameng K3 & APD |
| `landmark-lab.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Fasad meja pusat & gapura laboratorium |
| `landmark-station1.png` | 1024x1024 | PNG RGBA | Fasad lemari & meja instrumen buret |
